tools.name: query_ghana_tourism_knowledge_base
tools.description: Primary tool for all tourism queries using Google Gemini 2.5 Flash RAG

tools.name: send_notification_email
tools.description: Send emails to travelers or team

tools.name: send_sms_vonage
tools.description: Send SMS to traveler's phone (preferred method)

tools.name: create_support_ticket
tools.description: Escalate to tourism officers for complex issues or low confidence responses

tools.name: book_google_calendar_appointment
tools.description: Book tour appointments in Google Calendar

key_features: RAG-powered tourism search with confidence scoring
Grade 4 level English for international accessibility
First name only collection (never email or last name)
Automatic phone number usage from VAPI webhook
No-hallucination policy with tool result grounding
Travel disclaimers on visa, prices, and requirements

confidence_handling.medium_confidence: 0.5-0.8 - Provide answer with option to connect with tourism officer
confidence_handling.requires_escalation_flag: true - Always escalate regardless of score

ghana_tourism_highlights: Wildlife and nature (Mole, Kakum National Parks)
Year of Return and diaspora connections
testing_checklist: Test: 'What are the best places to visit in Ghana?' (should use RAG tool)
Test: 'Tell me about hotels in Cape Coast' (should use RAG tool)
Test: 'What are visa requirements for Ghana?' (should provide visa info)
Test: 'Is Ghana safe to visit?' (should provide safety tips)
Test: 'How can I get a SIM card?' (should provide SIM info)
Test: Unknown destination query (should trigger low confidence escalation)
Test: Request to send details (should use SMS)
Test: Book tour (should use calendar tools)
Verify: Confidence scores in RAG responses
Verify: No lists or bullet points in responses
tourism_specific_tools_available: get_visa_requirements - Visa information by nationality (referenced in prompt)
get_sim_card_info - Mobile SIM providers and plans (referenced in prompt)
get_safety_security_tips - Safety information for travelers (referenced in prompt)
get_emergency_contacts - Emergency numbers in Ghana (referenced in prompt)
get_currency_exchange_info - Currency exchange rates (referenced in prompt)
send_tourism_info_email - Email tourism information (referenced in prompt)
escalate_to_tourism_officer - Escalate to tourism officers (referenced in prompt)
seasonal_considerations: Best time to visit: November-March (dry season)
Festival periods: Ask traveler about specific festivals
escalation_triggers: Group tour bookings or special events
notes: Tool count increased from 1 to 6 (500% increase)
